newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firmer, ARA refinery product scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firmer, ARA refinery product scarce.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firmer on Thursday with running refinery material seen scarce in the ARA region, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded some $2 higher at $214.50 and $215.
"There's little around on the refinery side, although storage material is a lot more aggressively offered," said one Rotterdam trader.
The fixture of at least two transatlantic cargoes in the last few days has helped to tighten up the market, traders said.
A 60,000 tonne conventional M5 cargo was sold on Wednesday at a discount of five cents to Jan NYMEX quotes, fob UK.
The deal was between a U.S. oil company with a U.K. refinery and a trading house. A 30,000 tonne cargo was also sold into the U.S. by a Belgian refiner to a Japanese trading house on a p+c basis.
A Dec swap traded early at $208.50 fob ARA, but levels fell in line with crude later to talk around $206.50/$207.50.
